prose: Anthropic is renaming its Claude subscription tiers: the $100/month Max 5x plan becomes simply Max, and the $200/month Max 20x becomes Ultra. Prices stay put and current subscribers need do nothing. The substantive change comes with the rename: Anthropic is removing the 5-hour usage limit for verified Ultra accounts, starting with most existing subscribers; newer accounts keep the limit for now.
highlights: Claude Max 5x becomes Max ($100/month); Max 20x becomes Ultra ($200/month)
Prices unchanged; no action needed from subscribers
The 5-hour usage limit is removed for verified Ultra accounts
Rollout starts with most existing subscribers; newer accounts keep the limit for now
